Homework 1 — Count-Min Sketch

Everything is submitted and graded on Gradescope. Do not upload anything here.

Submit here: Gradescope → Homework 1 - Count-Min Sketch
If the course is missing from your Gradescope dashboard, join it first with entry code 5D86WB, using the university email address on your student record.

Assigned: 07.09.2026  •  Due: 20.09.2026, 23:59  •  Weight: 100 points, autograded  •  Individual work

Implement a count-min sketch in C++: a probabilistic frequency counter that uses a fixed amount of memory and never underestimates a count. Read the handout below first - it explains the data structure with a worked example, lists exactly what each method must do, shows what the tests expect, and walks through submitting and reading your results.

Files attached below:

  • homework1.pdf - the assignment handout. Read this first.
  • hw1-starter.zip - the starter kit: skeleton code, the tests you are given, and a bundled googletest. Nothing else to download.

You may resubmit on Gradescope as often as you like before the deadline. Getting a working version in early is worth points, so start now rather than the night before.

  • homework1.pdf
  • hw1-starter.zip
